lines: My war game has eight hidden cards. Almost nobody will ever find this one.
hook
Every soldier here is a real person from my comments. And any of them can find these.
real
Go on a night raid. Search the enemy you left in the crater.
raid
Some raiders come back with this.
raid2
Crawl out at night to mend the wire. Sometimes the mud gives something back.
wire
Or just write to your soldier. Once in a while, there is a card inside the letter from home.
letter
Five are common. Two are rare.
rarity
And one is legendary. Wings. One card in twenty.
wings
If your soldier falls, the cards go to the heir. Nobody throws one away.
heir
More missions are coming, and more ways to find them.
more
Comment HEGEMONY or CONCORD, and your soldier joins the war. Then go find them.
cta
Mud and Iron. Free at mudandiron dot app.
end
